desc: Derive the interpretation of removal histories as noncrossing matchings, with one unmatched index for odd N.
Validate or refute the maximum-current-adjacent-difference greedy rule using an exact small-N oracle; it is false.
Derive the binary threshold characterization and prove the sorted-extremes formula for even segments.
Derive the odd-length decomposition by the surviving odd-indexed position.
Develop an O(N log N) heap-based algorithm for all even prefixes and suffixes.
Produce the stdin/stdout implementation and validate it on all public samples.
